issues.problem: NVIDIA's net income for fiscal 2024 was about $29.8 billion ($29,760 million), not $37.2 billion. The stated figure also can't be right on its face: it would be higher than the $33.0 billion operating income, even though NVIDIA had income tax expense that year.

data.summary: These figures are correct: revenue of $60.9B, up about 125.9% from $27.0B; operating income of about $33.0B; total assets of about $65.7B; and cash and cash equivalents of about $7.3B. Net income is wrong. The real figure was about $29.8B, not $37.2B.
